name: Zeus Brundle
source:
Likes: To be a boss
Dislikes: To obey someone
Hobby: Getting Hiro puzzled with a sudden favor
Skill: Creating magic circles

"Who do you think I am? I'm the pinnacle of all creations, alive or dead!"

Randy: Hey hey heeeey!
Have you heard about the man named Zeus Brundle?!
He is the Prefect of the Night Class, who is good at casting a summoning magic.
He and Klaus fight like cats and dogs!
I know they hate to admit it but they are two of a kind, at least I think so...
Oops! Klaus is heading towards me!
Gotta go!

[Official in-game description]
